_comment: Local development only, layered on top of appsettings.json (standard ASP.NET Core Development-environment config). Nothing here is a secret — Mailpit takes no auth on its SMTP port — so unlike the Stripe/PlayServices sections in appsettings.json, this file needs no placeholder dance and is safe to commit as-is.

Smtp._comment: Points at Mailpit (docker-compose.yml). Forge.Infrastructure.DependencyInjection.AddForgeAuth registers the real Forge.Infrastructure.Email.SmtpEmailSender instead of LoggingEmailSender whenever Smtp:Host is set — read the mail Mailpit catches at http://localhost:8025.
